product_overview: Math Teacher Smart Platform is an educational web app for Arabic-speaking users that provides role-based access to student and admin experiences. It supports secure login and a student online dashboard for viewing homework.
core_goals: Allow users to sign in with their account credentials
Let online students access their authenticated dashboard
Enable students to view assigned homework

features.name: User Login
features.description: Users can authenticate with their email and password to access the platform.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email -> Enter password -> Submit the login form -> See the authenticated dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Enter an invalid email or password -> Submit the login form -> See a login failure message

features.name: Student Online Dashboard
features.description: Authenticated online students can access their student area after signing in.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter student credentials -> Submit the login form -> Navigate to /student-online -> See the student online dashboard

features.name: View Homework
features.description: Authenticated students can open the homework section and review the assigned homework list.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter student credentials -> Submit the login form -> Navigate to /student-online -> Navigate to /student-online/homework -> See the homework list
Navigate to /login -> Enter student credentials -> Submit the login form -> Navigate to /student-online/homework -> See the homework list
